description: DS-to-DS federation endpoint: deliver an MLS Welcome message for a new member to a remote delivery service.

main.description: Accept a Welcome message for a new member from a remote DS. The recipient must be a local user on this DS. If the conversation already exists locally, the caller must be the sequencer DS.

convoId.description: Conversation identifier the recipient is being added to

recipientDid.description: DID of the local user who should receive the Welcome

senderDsDid.description: DID of the sending delivery service (must match JWT issuer)

keyPackageHash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the key package consumed for this Welcome

initialEpoch.description: MLS epoch number for the group at the time of the Welcome

groupInfo.description: Optional base64-encoded MLS GroupInfo for the recipient to use with external commits

accepted.description: Whether the Welcome was accepted and stored for the recipient

ack.description: Optional cryptographic acknowledgement signed by the receiving DS

errors.name: RecipientNotFound
errors.description: The recipient DID is not a local user on this DS

errors.name: ConversationNotFound
errors.description: The conversation exists locally but the caller is not its sequencer

errors.name: AuthFailed
errors.description: JWT validation failed or senderDsDid does not match JWT issuer

deliveryAck.description: Cryptographic receipt acknowledging Welcome delivery, signed by the receiving DS.

welcomeId.description: Server-generated identifier for the stored Welcome

epoch.description: The initial epoch from the Welcome

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over (welcomeId, convoId, epoch)
